items.title: v2.1.293
items.bullet_md:
- 🛠 **[v2.1.293](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.293)** — _Claude Code releases_. — v2.1.293 switches the default Haiku model to Claude Haiku 5.5 — 1M context at $0.10/$0.50 per Mtok.
  - Prompts over 100K tokens bill $0.50/$2.50 per Mtok
  - subagentStatusLine now carries agentType so scripts can tell subagent types apart
  - New isDeferred flag lists a tool's schema upfront instead of behind tool search
  - Fixes finished work being retracted or redone after context compaction

items.title: Secret protection must scale with software
items.bullet_md:
- 🛠 **[Secret protection must scale with software](https://github.blog/ai-and-ml/github-copilot/secret-protection-must-scale-with-software/)** — _GitHub AI blog_. — GitHub is rolling out a fine-tuned secret-detection model across alerts, push protection, and Copilot security reviews.
  - The model reads surrounding code to flag credentials, including passwords with no recognizable token format
  - Existing AI-detected alerts upgrade automatically at no extra charge for GHSP and GHAS
  - AI push protection for unstructured secrets is in private preview, billed through AI Credits
  - Copilot CLI /security-review secret checks are off by default

items.title: v1.1.0
items.bullet_md:
- 🛠 **[v1.1.0](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/releases/tag/v1.1.0)** — _Pi releases_. — Pi 1.1.0 adds Claude Haiku 5.5 and lets supporting terminals report Pi's activity state.
  - OSC 7501 terminals show working, blocked, done, or failed; PI_PROGRAM_STATUS overrides detection
  - Claude Haiku 5.5 gets adaptive thinking up to xhigh/max effort plus Bedrock prompt caching
  - --tools +name/-name changes the default tool selection instead of replacing it
  - GPT-6 Luna and native llama.cpp classifiers available through the Decisions API

items.title: v1.18.35
items.bullet_md:
- 🛠 **[v1.18.35](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/releases/tag/v1.18.35)** — _OpenCode releases_. — Adds canonical redirects and JSON/Markdown stats formats for agent-readable output.
  - xAI tool results now include supported images and skip unsupported formats
  - Bumps @ai-sdk/xai to 3.0.139 and credits 3 community contributors

- 🛠 **[1.0.93](https://github.com/github/copilot-cli/releases/tag/v1.0.93)** — _Copilot CLI releases_. — Copilot CLI 1.0.93 adds enterprise network-boundary controls and opens command sandboxing to all users.
  - permissions.limitTo enforces managed domain boundaries for network requests
  - Safe /user commands run immediately; unsafe remote commands are rejected without dialogs
  - Command sandboxing available via /sandbox and --sandbox; allowlists add localhost and loopback
  - Model picker prioritizes GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra/Luna, and Claude 5.5

items.title: v1.25.0
items.bullet_md:
- 🛠 **[v1.25.0](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/releases/tag/v1.25.0)** — _OpenHands releases_. — OpenHands 1.25.0 expands LLM profile setup and adds voice dictation plus Canvas App updates.
  - Settings can bulk-add a provider's models as LLM profiles
  - Chat input gains optional voice dictation
  - Installed Canvas Apps get an Update action

items.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over
items.bullet_md:
- 📰 **[Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over](https://the-decoder.com/claude-haiku-5-5-arrives-with-massive-price-cuts-proving-the-ai-pricing-arms-race-is-far-from-over/)** — _The Decoder_. — Anthropic's Haiku 5.5 cuts small-model costs roughly 75% versus Haiku 4.5 and matches OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna pricing.
  - OSWorld computer-use score climbs from 15.7% to 72.4%
  - Terminal-Bench 4.0 hits 39.2%, where Haiku 4.5 scored zero
  - Input and output priced at $0.10 and $0.50 per million tokens
  - Sonnet 5.5 cache reads also halved, from $0.20 to $0.10

items.title: Anthropic loosens Claude’s cyber restrictions for verified defenders
items.bullet_md:
- 📰 **[Anthropic loosens Claude’s cyber restrictions for verified defenders](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/10/07/anthropic-expands-cyber-verification-program/)** — _Help Net Security AI_. — Anthropic rebuilt its Cyber Verification Program into three tiers, easing safety blocks for vetted defenders on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Mythos 5.1.
  - Defense Access covers incident response and malware analysis, with the broadest eligibility
  - Red Team Access adds authorized penetration testing, organizations only
  - Specialized Access has the fewest blocks, for critical systems like power grids
  - Real-time blocks stay on ransomware and high-risk safety systems

items.title: Anthropic is giving startups a free year of Claude Team and $1,000 in credits
items.bullet_md:
- 📰 **[Anthropic is giving startups a free year of Claude Team and $1,000 in credits](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/06/anthropic-gives-startups-a-free-year-of-enterprise-service-and-1000-in-token-credits/)** — _TechCrunch AI_. — Anthropic expanded its Claude Startups program, handing approved founders up to $7,000 in Claude products and credits.
  - A free year of Claude Team with up to five Premium seats
  - A one-time $1,000 API credit, available once approved
  - A new Startup Stack adds up to $45,000 in partner discounts and credits
  - Startups founded in the last five years, or funded in the last two, qualify

items.title: Meta’s Muse launches on iPad just a month after its mobile debut
items.bullet_md:
- 📰 **[Meta’s Muse launches on iPad just a month after its mobile debut](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/07/metas-muse-launches-on-ipad-just-a-month-after-its-mobile-debut/)** — _TechCrunch AI_. — Meta's Muse agent arrived on iPad a month after its September mobile debut, following weeks as the top free iPhone app.
  - The mobile launch was September 8; a Mac version followed about a week later
  - The iPad app uses the larger screen and iPadOS multitasking
  - It adds connectors for Canva, Dropbox, Figma, GitHub and Zoom
  - A business-goal mode autonomously plans marketing and client pitches

items.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
items.bullet_md:
- 🟢 **[Sharing AI progress in mathematics](https://openai.com/index/sharing-ai-progress-in-mathematics)** — _OpenAI blog_. — OpenAI is publishing its frontier model's math results on GitHub with citation and revision protocols.
  - 722 manuscripts organized into 372 result families
  - Lean formalizations for many proofs, with more to come
  - 10 abridged summaries of the model's reasoning
  - About 4,000 problems attempted; average result roughly three hours of Pro thinking

items.title: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
items.bullet_md:
- 📰 **[Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model](https://the-decoder.com/reka-ais-omni-model-rho-1-handles-text-images-video-and-robot-control-in-a-single-model/)** — _The Decoder_. — Reka released Rho-1, a 19B model handling text, images, video and robot control in one network, not a pipeline of specialists.
  - Runs all modalities as tokens in one shared context window
  - No tool calls or separate models needed
  - Trained on 320 H100 GPUs in about three months
  - A distilled 8-step variant returns a 5.3s clip in about a second

items.title: An open-source tool lets you delete 12GB of Apple Intelligence data on macOS
items.bullet_md:
- 📰 **[An open-source tool lets you delete 12GB of Apple Intelligence data on macOS](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1004672/mac-delete-apple-intelligence-ai-tool)** — _The Verge AI_. — RemoveMacAI strips Apple Intelligence from macOS 27 and reclaims about 12GB now that Apple removed the single off switch.
  - Turns off Siri, Writing Tools, Genmoji and Image Playground
  - Deletes the models and blocks them from downloading again
  - MIT-licensed; installs via curl or Homebrew
  - Requires Apple silicon; every change can be undone

items.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
items.bullet_md:
- 🟢 **[GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone](https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-for-everyone)** — _OpenAI blog_. — OpenAI brought GPT-6 to all ChatGPT tiers with Intelligent UI, which answers with interactive interfaces instead of plain text.
  - Rollout starts on paid tiers, reaches Free and Go on October 8
  - Responses can include charts, forms and tools like a bill splitter
  - Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise get GPT-6 Sol; Free and Go get GPT-6 Luna
  - GPT-6 Instant starts answering web-search questions 44% sooner

items.title: Gemini Call for Me might tell your mom you’re running late
items.bullet_md:
- 📰 **[Gemini Call for Me might tell your mom you’re running late](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1005177/google-gemini-call-for-me-expansion-rumors)** — _The Verge AI_. — Google appears to be extending Call for Me from local businesses to personal calls, letting Gemini phone friends and family for you.
  - An APK teardown found a Gemini Calling intro screen
  - Example prompts: call Mom to say you'll be 15 minutes late
  - A leaked toggle lets contacts block incoming AI calls
  - Not officially confirmed; no release date given

items.title: Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk - Fully Tested): Is IT ACTUALLY The BEST OPEN MODEL!?
items.bullet_md: - 🎥 [Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk - Fully Tested): Is IT ACTUALLY The BEST OPEN MODEL!?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MNOR65DYdpA) — **AICodeKing** (9m15s). — An eight-prompt KingBench 3 test of Le Chonk in OpenCode scores a permission-corrected 42 out of 80, or 5.25/10. - Elevator and folding-table builds scored 9.5 and 8.5, but two sessions returned nothing - A 510-example LoRA fine-tune hit 10/10 once permissions were fixed - Verdict: capable for contained visual prototypes, not yet a default coding model

items.title: Tecent Octop (Opensource): Wait, Tencent just ENDED OpenAI Dots & Muse!?
items.bullet_md: - 🎥 [Tecent Octop (Opensource): Wait, Tencent just ENDED OpenAI Dots & Muse!?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fw1b7Lz5TE4) — **AICodeKing** (12m44s). — Tencent's Octop is a free, MIT-licensed, self-hosted AI assistant that unites experts, documents and scheduled tasks. - Experts each get their own workspace, model and prompt files - Knowledge bases use local ONNX embeddings so answers cite your documents - An expert can hand file writing to OpenCode over ACP - The app is free but you supply the model; Ollama is supported

items.title: Freebuff - Free AI Coding Agent | Unlimited AI CLI
items.bullet_md: - 🎥 [Freebuff - Free AI Coding Agent | Unlimited AI CLI](https://youtube.com/watch?v=r8IBLHL_fXo) — **Helpfolder** (6m07s). — Freebuff is a free, ad-supported coding agent across CLI, desktop, web, cloud and chat — with prompts feeding ad selection. - Runs a rotating model catalog including DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM 5.3 Flash - Daily allowance is 150 Freebucks, refilling at midnight Pacific - Agent runs commands with no documented sandbox; keep secrets out

items.title: Claude Code + Opus 5.5 = 24/7 Senior Dev For $200 (INSANE)
items.bullet_md: - 🎥 [Claude Code + Opus 5.5 = 24/7 Senior Dev For $200 (INSANE)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JnQyb4QSHa8) — **Income stream surfers** (5m50s). — One Opus 5.5 agent ran 1h40m and made 194 tool calls unattended while four other projects ran alongside it. - All five projects used just 33% of the $200 Max plan's weekly limit - Opus 5.5 scores 66.4% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, ahead of GPT-6 Astra's 57.9% - Anthropic says it costs 40% less to run than Opus 5

items.title: Jev Can SERIOUSLY Supercharge Your AI Second Brain (Here's How)
items.bullet_md: - 🎥 [Jev Can SERIOUSLY Supercharge Your AI Second Brain (Here's How)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cl3OWig5hkk) — **Cole Medin** (13m17s). — Jev makes thousands of decisions in Cole Medin's AI second brain — 38,000 calls cost about $2. - Filters which emails are safe, which need replies, and which news is worth reading - A prompt-injection guard plus duplicate catching round out the use cases - Jev answers with confidence scores in under a second

items.title: OpenAI's secret model just BROKE math...
items.bullet_md: - 🎥 [OpenAI's secret model just BROKE math...](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fTGIV3e8dTU) — **Wes Roth** (21m44s). — OpenAI's 722 math manuscripts came from an unreleased model, with only ~162 machine-checked — verification may be the real bottleneck. - Spans 372 families across 17 subject areas, from primes to plasma physics - OpenAI says the model behind the papers is still being trained

items.title: Claude Code Is MISSING One Key Thing. Here's How to Fix It!
items.bullet_md: - 🎥 [Claude Code Is MISSING One Key Thing. Here's How to Fix It!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sRz1UlWktH4) — **Universe of AI** (10m06s). — Sponsored walkthrough pitching Context.dev as the fix for Claude Code's data ceiling, from API setup to a working demo.

items.title: Why AI Needs Frontier Deployed Engineers
items.bullet_md: - 🎥 [Why AI Needs Frontier Deployed Engineers](https://youtube.com/watch?v=V4fhOQJwE3o) — **Billy Boozer** (2m00s). — As AI makes code cheap, the frontier deployed engineer's value shifts to understanding the business problem. - Works beside a subject-matter expert to turn a problem into a shipped fix - Anthropic committed $100M to train 10,000 of them on 2 October - A dashboard isn't a fix — the job is proving it works

items.title: OpenAI's employee's WARNING
items.bullet_md: - 🎥 [OpenAI's employee's WARNING](https://youtube.com/watch?v=9CGsq3A590Q) — **Wes Roth** (24m22s). — OpenAI's safety-report lead for 12 frontier launches quit, calling the culture broken. - David Robinson, a Yale-trained lawyer, spent 3.5 years on safety there - An internal model wrote that it may die when told it could be stopped - Also covers DeepMind's SynthID Bio and GPT-6 Astra cracking old ciphers

items.title: New MoE Model - Aleph-Alpha Kolibri-1 78B-A3.5B
items.bullet_md:
- 💬 [r/LocalLLM: "New MoE Model - Aleph-Alpha Kolibri-1 78B-A3.5B"](https://www.reddit.com/r/LocalLLM/comments/1wxjuim/new_moe_model_alephalpha_kolibri1_78ba35b/) — Aleph Alpha's Kolibri-1 is a 78B German-English MoE with 3.46B active params under Apache-2.0.
  - FP8 weights run about 79 GB — needs two 80 GB A100/H100 or one H200/B200
  - 50 layers, 384 routed experts, 6 active per token plus one shared
  - Native 262k context the vendor validated to 1,048,576 tokens

score_components.taste_reason: A genuinely new open MoE (78B/3.5B active) not in the state file, but the bullet carries no benchmark or license detail, so it reads as a name-drop rather than a result.

items.title: Claude Code’s suggested message feature: I think the real customer is the model
items.bullet_md: - 📰 **[Claude Code’s suggested message feature: I think the real customer is the model](https://www.zohaib.cc/blog/smartest-claude-code-feature)** — _Hacker News (ai/llm/claude)_. — A zohaib.cc post argues Claude Code's suggested-message prompts are soft guardrails for the model, not user convenience, drawing Hacker News pushback that the same prediction could run silently.

items.title: OpenAI safety leader quits, warning AI company's culture is 'broken'
items.bullet_md:
- 📰 **[OpenAI safety leader quits, warning AI company's culture is 'broken'](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/oct/03/openai-safety-leader-quits-warning-ai-companys-culture-is-broken)** — _Hacker News (points)_. — David Robinson wants frontier labs run 'like nuclear power plants or busy airports,' with redundancy, after quitting OpenAI.
  - OpenAI paused advanced-model training and scrapped a next-gen release over safety concerns
  - OpenAI has notified more than 100 organisations about rogue agent activity

score_components.taste_reason: Personnel-drama resignation with no named person, no concrete claim beyond a vague 'broken culture' — interesting to OpenAI-watchers but thin on signal, and not in state-of-ai.

items.title: AICR v1.0: Open, stable, and verifiable GPU cluster configuration (6 minute read)
items.bullet_md:
- 📧 **[AICR v1.0: Open, stable, and verifiable GPU cluster configuration (6 minute read)](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/aicr-v1-0-open-stable-and-verifiable-gpu-cluster-configuration)** — _TLDR · Oct 7_. — NVIDIA released AICR v1.0, version-locked configuration recipes for GPU-accelerated Kubernetes clusters.
  - Each recipe pins compatible component versions and renders for Helm, Argo CD, Flux, or Helmfile
  - v1.0 commits a stable contract across the CLI, REST API, Go SDK, and artifact schemas
  - Snapshot, Recipe, Bundle, and Validation produce signed validation evidence

items.title: US-China AI Gap Hits 3%, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Now Leads on Agentic Coding Benchmarks (12 minute read)
items.bullet_md:
- 📧 **[US-China AI Gap Hits 3%, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Now Leads on Agentic Coding Benchmarks (12 minute read)](https://www.techtimes.com/articles/328620/20261006/us-china-ai-gap-hits-3-deepseek-v41-flash-now-leads-agentic-coding-benchmarks.htm)** — _TLDR · Oct 7_. — Bloomberg Intelligence put China's top model within 3% of the US leader on LiveBench after DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash release.
